public.text: The phrase “all facilities…of direct relevance to the Ministry of Health’s mandate” may not cover decentralised systems in which subnational governments, regulators, defence authorities, or private bodies hold relevant authority.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with “within the nationally defined scope of health-sector and public-health oversight,” allowing authority to be distributed according to the country’s legal and institutional arrangements.
